title: 'I pulled the controls': Passenger tells Israeli PM how he helped stop attacker
description: The man says he "pulled the controls" of the plane after it plummeted during the attack.

title: UK believes Iran involved in RAF Fairford incident, PM says
description: The prime minister's comments come days after the suspects were released on the 'strictest possible bail conditions'.

title: UK-France 'one in, one out' migrant scheme scrapped
description: Some 1,500 people have been removed to France since the scheme began just over a year ago.

title: China funding UK research and sending it to Beijing's spies, MI5 warns
description: British universities are being urged to sever ties with China General Technology Research Institute which is linked to the Chinese Ministry of State Security (MSS).

title: Teens who died in car that entered River Wear named
description: Jackson Duke, Luke Etheridge and Zara Shaw died when the car they were in ended up in the River Wear.

title: Brexit referendum 'possible' in Labour election manifesto, Burnham tells BBC
description: The PM says a referendum wouldn't be the right thing now but the UK needs to consider its options for the future.

title: Execution of US murderer Christa Pike halted shortly before it was due to happen
description: Pike was convicted and sentenced to death in 1996 for the murder of Colleen Slemmer.

title: We fear for our lives after being told our abusive exes will be freed from jail early
description: Three victims of domestic abuse tell the BBC why they feel let down by the early prisoner release scheme.

title: Ronaldo leaves Portugal camp after coach denies rift
description: Cristiano Ronaldo says he has left Portugal's international camp and will explain why "in time", hours after head coach Jorge Jesus denied any rift with the player.
